summary: Completed testing of Admin User Management features. Backend tests: 14/14 passed. Frontend: Fixed critical bug in Users.js where token was undefined causing 401 errors. All features now working.

minor.issue: Resend API key is invalid - falls back to console logging (MOCK INVITE EMAIL). Not a blocker.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED: Token from useAuth() was undefined when Users component mounted, causing 401 errors on /api/admin/users. Fixed by reading token directly from localStorage in loadUsers().

action_items: Consider fixing AuthContext.js to make token a state variable that updates on login (root cause of the Users.js issue)
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.js line 19: token is read from localStorage once on mount, not as a state variable. This causes race conditions where components try to use token before it's set after login.
Users.js: Fixed to read token directly from localStorage in loadUsers() as a workaround
seed_data_creation: Created test users via invite flow during testing (prefixed with TEST_)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin User Management features fully tested. Key data-testid attributes: invite-user-btn, invite-modal, invite-first-name, invite-last-name, invite-email, invite-username, send-invite-btn, invite-accept-page, invite-first-name-input, invite-last-name-input, invite-username-input, invite-email-field, invite-password-input, invite-confirm-password-input, invite-submit-btn, invite-success-card, reset-pw-{user_id}, reset-pw-modal, reset-pw-input, confirm-reset-pw-btn, user-row-{user_id}. The Users.js fix reads token from localStorage directly to avoid race condition with AuthContext.

features_tested.feature: Admin login with credentials administrator / Admin@123
features_tested.details: Admin can log in and navigate to Team & Access page

features_tested.feature: Invite User modal with extended fields
features_tested.details: Modal has First Name, Last Name, Email, Username, Role selector, Org/Bot assignment, Send Invite button. All data-testid attributes present.
Opening /invite/{token} shows pre-filled first_name, last_name, username from invite. Email is read-only. Password fields work correctly.
Submitting invite acceptance form creates user, shows success card with 'Welcome to BitBot Pro!' message
User created via invite can login with their username and password
Reset Password button opens modal, admin can set new password, user can login with new password

features_tested.feature: Team page table displays user details
features_tested.details: Table shows name, email, username, assigned orgs, bots, verification status, and action buttons (role toggle, reset password, delete)
